grid.encoding: little-endian uint16; linear height encoding via each entry's encodingRangeM
grid.sampleOrder: longitude increases eastward from 0 degrees; rows increase from south to north
grid.gpuBump: R8/LUMINANCE8, linear filtering, no mip chain; full uint16 values remain on CPU for relief

earth.name: Earth — NOAA ETOPO5 global relief
earth.coverage: Global simple-cylindrical grid; source-native latitude coordinates; east-positive longitude
earth.referenceShape: WGS84 reference ellipsoid; no local geoid-to-ellipsoid correction
earth.verticalDatum: ETOPO5 mean-sea-level elevation / ocean-floor depth; meters

mercury.name: Mercury — MESSENGER global DEM
mercury.source: USGS Astrogeology MESSENGER Global DEM 665 m, version 2
mercury.coverage: Global simple-cylindrical grid; source-native latitude coordinates; east-positive longitude
mercury.verticalDatum: MESSENGER DEM elevation relative to the 2,439,400 m reference radius; meters

venus.name: Venus — Magellan global topography
venus.source: Magellan Global Topographic Data Record GTDR-SINUS.3 version 2; USGS Astrogeology distribution
venus.coverage: Global simple-cylindrical grid; source-native latitude coordinates; east-positive longitude
venus.verticalDatum: Magellan altimetry elevation relative to the 6,051,000 m reference radius; meters

mars.name: Mars — MOLA MEGDR global topography
mars.source: NASA MGS MOLA MEGDR, 16 pixels/degree, product version 2.0
mars.coverage: Global simple-cylindrical grid; source-native latitude coordinates; east-positive longitude
mars.verticalDatum: GMM3 (mgm1025) degree/order 50 areoid; meters; no local areoid-to-ellipsoid correction

moon.name: Moon — LOLA LDEM 16 pixels/degree
moon.source: NASA GSFC Scientific Visualization Studio CGI Moon Kit, LRO/LOLA LDEM_16_UINT
moon.resolution: 16 pixels/degree (about 1.9 km/pixel), cylindrical map centered at 0 degrees longitude
moon.coverage: Global simple-cylindrical grid; source-native latitude coordinates; east-positive longitude
moon.verticalDatum: LOLA elevations relative to 1,737,400 m; unsigned DN is offset by 20,000 at 0.5 m per DN
